contexts.text: May be compared to the nauseous stench... from indigestion.
Relate to such things in the stomach as are undigested.
These (Spirits) love undigested and malignant things...
They love... stinking things, such as are exhaled from the undigested things of the stomach.
The blood of the heart purifies itself in the lungs from undigested things. Explained.
Like food... which remains undigested in the stomach...
Without distinct order in a man's mind... what would there be except what is confused and undigested.
Whenever they spoke, there occurred a kind of indigestion of the stomach...
Some who have (merely) general affection... induced... a kind of indigestion in the stomach; because there is but little vital in such a general affection.
3. The blood flows into (the lungs) undigested and impure...
